values.note: 2026 rates (non-resident): standard sites $38, pull-through sites $43; +$5/night on holidays and special events. Oakland County residents pay $5 less Sunday-Thursday: $33/$38. Monthly discount only for a full month of consecutive camping on one site. $10 fee to change or cancel a reservation. Site fee includes day-use privileges.

fees.source: https://www.oakgov.com/community/oakland-county-parks/reservations-purchases/addison-oaks-camping-fees ('2026 Addison Oaks Camping Fees'; 'Standard Sites: $38/night, Oakland County Residents: $33/night (Sunday-Thursday)'; 'Pull Through Sites: $43/night, Oakland County Residents: $38/night (Sunday-Thursday)'; 'Holiday/Special Events: additional $5/night') + camping page ('$10 reservation modification/cancellation fee'; 'Site fee includes day-use privileges'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://cdn.oaklandcountymi.gov/oakland-sitefinity-prod/docs/default-source/parks-recreation-docs/parks-trails/addison-oaks/addison-oaks-camper-guide-2026.pdf ('All sites have water and 20/30/50 amp electrical service except sites 133-174, which have 20/30 amp'; 'All wastewater (gray/black) must be disposed of at the designated dump station(s)') + camping page ('All campsites are modern with electricity and water on site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites 133-174 have 20/30 amp only. Also five group camping areas, 2-, 4- or 6-person cabins and 6-person yurts.

sites.source: https://www.oakgov.com/community/oakland-county-parks/parks-trails/addison-oaks/camping ('Addison Oaks has 180 campsites available') + 2026 camper guide ('180 campsites, five group camping areas'; map legend 'PULL THROUGH SITE') + fees page ('Pull Through Sites: $43/night'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://cdn.oaklandcountymi.gov/oakland-sitefinity-prod/docs/default-source/parks-recreation-docs/parks-trails/addison-oaks/addison-oaks-camper-guide-2026.pdf ('Dumpsters are in Areas A and C, across from the shower buildings, and at the dump station'; map legend 'Laundry'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online (Oakland County Parks WebTrac) or call 248-858-1400, 180 days ahead. 'Reservations that include a Friday or Saturday must be two nights minimum.' Full payment at booking. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m. Changes and cancellations by phone or in person only.

booking.source: https://www.oakgov.com/community/oakland-county-parks/parks-trails/addison-oaks/camping ('Reservations for campsites, cabins and yurts are accepted 180 days ... in advance'; 'Reservations can be made by calling Addison Oaks at 248-858-1400 or booking online'; 'Reservations that include a Friday or Saturday must be two nights minimum'; 'Check-in time: 3 p.m. Check-out time: 1 p.m.'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.oakgov.com/community/oakland-county-parks/recreation/camping-faqs (county answer on camper discounts names only the monthly rate) + Addison Oaks fees page (only the monthly discount), read 2026-10-22; the military flag came only from the Good Sam directory

note: Oakland County Parks campground at Addison Oaks County Park (1,140 acres, two lakes), with group areas, cabins and yurts. Drive-in back-in and pull-through sites across areas A-D; area D wooded for trailers. Buhl Lake swim beach, fishing, boat and bike rental, disc golf; themed activities on summer weekends. --Claude
summary: Oakland County Parks pages and 2026 camper guide: 180 sites, water and 20/30/50-amp at all but sites 133-174 (20/30), no sewer (dump station), showers, laundry; season May 1 - Oct 14 (closed now for the season); 2026 non-resident $38 standard / $43 pull-through, residents $5 less Sun-Thu, holidays +$5; WebTrac or 248-858-1400, 180 days out, two-night Fri/Sat minimum. Base rate corrected from the resident $33 to the non-resident $38 (resident rate now in fees.note). Cleared the Good Sam-directory military flag. Note trimmed of site, hookup, season, price and booking facts. Phone 248-693-2432 (contact station) matches.
